description: AI-powered HR management toolkit with 21 MCP tools — parse PDFs/DOCX, extract skills, detect patterns, score candidates, and manage an ATS pipeline.
author: XJTLUmedia

tool_signatures.name: Classification
tool_signatures.description: Named Entity Recognition with domain-aware disambiguation

tool_signatures.name: Ingestion
tool_signatures.description: File format detection and binary-to-string conversion

tool_signatures.name: Rejected
tool_signatures.description: Build and maintain our Next.js-based web application. Work with designers to implement pixel-perfect UI components. Optimize for performance and accessibility.

tool_signatures.name: Sanitization
tool_signatures.description: Removal of stop words, special characters, and non-ASCII artifacts

tool_signatures.name: Serialization
tool_signatures.description: Mapping labeled tokens to JSON schema for database insertion

tool_signatures.name: Tokenization
tool_signatures.description: Splitting text into discrete word/phrase units with TF-IDF scoring

tool_signatures.name: analyze_resume
tool_signatures.description: Unified resume analysis tool. Select which analysis aspects to run via the

tool_signatures.name: assess_candidate
tool_signatures.description: Assess a resume against recruiter-defined criteria. Supports 8 criteria axes: Education, Experience, Skills, Certifications, Knowledge Stack, Competitions, Thresholds, and Job Qualification. Returns per-axis scores, weighted overall score, and a pass/review/reject decision.

tool_signatures.name: ats-pipeline-summary
tool_signatures.description: Generate a concise ATS pipeline summary showing candidate counts by stage and key hiring metrics.

tool_signatures.name: ats_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Unified ATS analytics. Select report type: -

tool_signatures.name: ats_communication
tool_signatures.description: Candidate communication management \u2014 create email templates with {{variable}} interpolation, preview and send messages, log inbound/outbound communications, search history, and get communication stats. Actions: create_template, list_templates, get_template, update_template, delete_template, preview, send, log, get_history, search_history, stats.

tool_signatures.name: ats_compliance
tool_signatures.description: Enterprise compliance toolkit: audit trail queries, EEO/EEOC diversity reporting, GDPR data export & erasure (right to be forgotten), data retention policy checks. Actions: query_audit, eeo_report, eeo_record, gdpr_export, gdpr_erase, retention_check, update_settings, get_settings.

tool_signatures.name: ats_generate_demo_data
tool_signatures.description: Generate a full set of realistic demo data for the ATS (Applicant Tracking System). Returns a complete ATSState with sample jobs, candidates at various pipeline stages, scheduled interviews, and offers. Useful for testing, demonstrations, or populating an empty ATS instance.

tool_signatures.name: ats_interview_feedback
tool_signatures.description: Manage interview feedback in the ATS. Actions: submit (add feedback to completed interview), get (retrieve feedback for an interview), update (modify existing feedback), delete (remove an interview), list_pending (interviews awaiting feedback), list_completed (interviews with feedback, optionally filtered by candidate), analyze (aggregate feedback for a candidate across all interviews), summary (hiring signal summary for a job or all jobs).

tool_signatures.name: ats_manage_candidates
tool_signatures.description: Unified candidate management for the ATS pipeline. Actions: CRUD: add, update, delete, move, bulk_move, list Analytics: rank (sort by fit), filter (by criteria), recommend_stage (suggest moves), compare (side-by-side), summarize (overview stats) Pass the current candidates record and an action. Returns updated state and/or analysis results.

tool_signatures.name: ats_manage_jobs
tool_signatures.description: Manage job postings in the ATS. Actions: create (new job posting), update (edit fields), delete, list (with optional status/department filter), search (by keyword in title/description), close, reopen. Pass current jobs record and an action.

tool_signatures.name: ats_manage_notes
tool_signatures.description: Manage candidate notes in the ATS. Actions: add (create note on candidate), update (edit note content), list (get all notes for a candidate), delete (remove a note), search (find notes by keyword across one or all candidates), bulk_add (add notes to multiple candidates). Pass the current candidates record.

tool_signatures.name: ats_manage_offers
tool_signatures.description: Manage offers in the ATS. Actions: create (validate & structure), update_status (draft\u2192pending-approval\u2192approved\u2192sent\u2192accepted/declined), delete (remove offer), list (all offers with optional filters), compare (side-by-side offer comparison), validate (check for issues). Returns structured offer data.

tool_signatures.name: ats_onboarding
tool_signatures.description: Post-hire onboarding checklist management. Create checklists with categorized tasks (paperwork, IT setup, training, orientation, compliance), track per-task progress, find overdue items, manage assignees. Actions: create, list, get, update_task, add_task, remove_task, progress, delete, overdue.

tool_signatures.name: ats_schedule_interview
tool_signatures.description: Full CRUD for interviews. Actions: create (validate & schedule with conflict detection), update (reschedule/modify), delete (permanent removal), list (filter by candidateId/jobId/status), get (single interview by id). Pass existing interviews record for conflict checks.

tool_signatures.name: ats_scorecard
tool_signatures.description: Structured interview scorecards \u2014 create evaluation templates with weighted criteria, fill scorecards per candidate/evaluator, update templates and entries, aggregate scores to rank candidates, ensure consistent hiring decisions. Actions: create_template, list_templates, get_template, update_template, delete_template, fill, get_entry, update_entry, get_candidate_scores, aggregate, delete_entry.

tool_signatures.name: ats_search
tool_signatures.description: Global search across the ATS. Actions: search (keyword search across candidates, jobs, interviews, offers \u2014 scoped optionally), filter_candidates (structured filter by stage/job/tags/score), get_entity (retrieve a single entity by type+id). Pass the full ATS state.

tool_signatures.name: ats_talent_pool
tool_signatures.description: Manage passive candidate talent pools (CRM). Create pools, add/remove candidates, search across pools, get pool analytics. Actions: create, update, delete, list, get, add_candidates, remove_candidates, search, analytics.

tool_signatures.name: batch_parse_resumes
tool_signatures.description: Parse multiple resume files at once and run the full algorithmic pipeline on each. Returns raw text, pipeline analysis, keywords, entities, and confidence scores for each file. The LLM client should interpret and structure the results.

tool_signatures.name: compare-candidates
tool_signatures.description: Parse and compare multiple candidates side-by-side for a position, ranking them by fit score.

tool_signatures.name: content
tool_signatures.description: Resume text, file content (base64), or URL to fetch

tool_signatures.name: criteria
tool_signatures.description: JSON array of evaluation criteria (e.g. required skills, experience years)

tool_signatures.name: export_results
tool_signatures.description: Export parsed resume results to a specified format (JSON, CSV, or Markdown). Accepts an array of structured resume results and returns formatted output.

tool_signatures.name: extract_experience
tool_signatures.description: Extract work experience from resume text using algorithmic date/metrics extraction combined with AI structuring. Uses pattern matching for metrics, date ranges, and section detection before AI refinement.

tool_signatures.name: extract_skills
tool_signatures.description: Extract skills from resume text using algorithmic keyword analysis combined with AI categorization. Uses TF-IDF keyword extraction and section detection before AI refinement.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_pipeline
tool_signatures.description: Run the full 5-node atomic deconstruction pipeline (Ingestion \u2192 Sanitization \u2192 Tokenization \u2192 Classification \u2192 Serialization) on resume text. Returns stage-by-stage metrics, confidence scores, entity classification with disambiguation, data quality assessment, and assumption audit. Use this to understand HOW the parser processes a resume and WHERE confidence is low.

tool_signatures.name: jobDescription
tool_signatures.description: Job description text to score candidates against

tool_signatures.name: jobId
tool_signatures.description: Optional job ID to filter pipeline stats to a single opening

tool_signatures.name: match_job
tool_signatures.description: Match a resume against a job description using cosine similarity, Jaccard index, TF-IDF keyword analysis, and AI assessment. Returns algorithmic scores combined with AI-refined compatibility analysis.

tool_signatures.name: parse-and-assess-candidate
tool_signatures.description: Parse a resume and assess the candidate

tool_signatures.name: parse_resume
tool_signatures.description: Parse a resume file (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD) or URL and extract text with algorithmic pre-analysis including keyword extraction, metrics detection, section identification, and experience estimation.

tool_signatures.name: parsing_health
tool_signatures.description: Monitor parsing quality, detect drift when resume formats change, submit human corrections, and view learned error patterns. Use

tool_signatures.name: resumes
tool_signatures.description: Newline-separated list of resume URLs or base64-encoded file contents

tool_signatures.name: role
tool_signatures.description: Job title or role the candidate is being assessed for

tool_signatures.name: send_email
tool_signatures.description: Send parsed resume results via email using SMTP. Requires SMTP configuration (host, port, user, pass) and recipient email. Sends an HTML summary of all results.

tool_signatures.name: summarize_resume
tool_signatures.description: Generate a recruiter-focused summary using algorithmic pre-analysis (TF-IDF keywords, metrics extraction, section detection, experience estimation) combined with AI synthesis.
